headers.name: base
headers.doc: The base of the Maul RHI API: the library and contract versions, the export and attribute macros, the result codes every fallible function returns, the allocator and the extension chain.

items.name: result
items.doc: The status a fallible function returns. Zero is success, positive values are outcomes that are not errors, negative values are errors. The type has a fixed width so that result structs have one layout in C and C++.

values.name: success
values.doc: The call did what was asked.

values.name: empty
values.doc: There is nothing to return: the notification queue is drained.

values.name: timeout
values.doc: A wait's deadline passed first; what it waited for is still running.

values.name: suboptimal
values.doc: A surface image was acquired and is usable, but the surface no longer matches its window as it could: configure it again soon.

values.name: occluded
values.doc: No surface image, since its window is hidden or has no size; the frame goes on without it.

values.name: error_invalid
values.doc: An argument is invalid: a null pointer where one is required, a value out of range, a def without its cookie.

values.name: error_capacity
values.doc: A caller buffer, a named limit or the allocator is too small for the result.

values.name: error_stale
values.doc: An id names an object that no longer exists.

values.name: error_unsupported
values.doc: This platform, driver or build cannot do what was asked, or a def carries a critical extension the library does not know.

values.name: error_platform
values.doc: The platform or its GPU driver failed a call the library made.

values.name: error_state
values.doc: The call is not allowed now, in the object's current state.

values.name: error_version
values.doc: The program was built against another contract version.

values.name: error_out_of_date
values.doc: A surface no longer matches its window: configure it again before acquiring.

values.name: error_device_lost
values.doc: The device is lost: the GPU was reset, removed or its driver failed.

items.name: version
items.doc: A library version: major, minor and patch.
items.library: the library's own version numbers

items.name: allocator
items.doc: The allocator an owner object takes in its def and keeps for its lifetime. Alignment is a power of two. A zeroed allocator means the C library's functions, which serve alignments up to that of max_align_t.
items.library: the program's memory for the library's own tables; GPU memory is the driver's

items.name: struct_type
items.doc: The type of a chained struct. Bit 31 clear marks a critical extension, which a library that does not know it refuses; bit 31 set marks a hint it may skip. Types with bit 30 set (MRHI_STRUCT_DRIVER_DEFINED) belong to drivers built outside the tree (mrhi-0024).

values.name: struct_none
values.doc: No struct: never valid in a chain.

values.name: struct_test_driver
values.doc: mrhiTestDriverDef, on an instance def: turns the test driver on.

values.name: struct_surface_source_win32
values.doc: mrhiSurfaceSourceWin32, on a surface def.

values.name: struct_surface_source_wayland
values.doc: mrhiSurfaceSourceWayland, on a surface def.

values.name: struct_surface_source_xcb
values.doc: mrhiSurfaceSourceXcb, on a surface def.

values.name: struct_surface_source_android
values.doc: mrhiSurfaceSourceAndroid, on a surface def.

values.name: struct_surface_source_metal_layer
values.doc: mrhiSurfaceSourceMetalLayer, on a surface def.

values.name: struct_surface_source_canvas
values.doc: mrhiSurfaceSourceCanvas, on a surface def.

values.name: struct_surface_source_test
values.doc: mrhiSurfaceSourceTest, on a surface def: a surface of the test driver.

values.name: struct_instance_vulkan_adopt
values.doc: mrhiInstanceVulkanAdopt, on an instance def: a VkInstance made elsewhere.

values.name: struct_instance_vulkan_extensions
values.doc: mrhiInstanceVulkanExtensions, on an instance def: extensions the Vulkan instance also enables.

values.name: struct_device_vulkan_adopt
values.doc: mrhiDeviceVulkanAdopt, on a device def: a VkDevice made from the instance's description.

values.name: struct_device_vulkan_extensions
values.doc: mrhiDeviceVulkanExtensions, on a device def: extensions the Vulkan device also enables.

values.name: struct_texture_vulkan_adopt
values.doc: mrhiTextureVulkanAdopt, on a texture def: a VkImage made elsewhere.

values.name: struct_external_driver
values.doc: mrhiExternalDriverDef, on an instance def: a driver made outside the library (mrhi-0024).

items.library: tags of the library's extension chain

items.name: struct_driver_defined
items.doc: The bit of a chained struct type defined by a driver built outside the tree: such a struct is a surface's source on an instance of that driver, handed to it unexamined, and refused everywhere else (mrhi-0024).

items.name: chain
items.doc: The header every chained struct opens with. A def's next field, or a chained struct's chain.next, points at the next struct of the chain, or is NULL.
items.library: the library's extension chain

items.name: label_bytes
items.doc: The bytes a debug label may take, in UTF-8.

items.name: request_id
items.doc: A request, answered by exactly one notification in its owner's queue.

items.name: get_version
items.doc: Returns the version of the library that was linked, which may differ from the MRHI_VERSION macros a program was compiled with.

returns.doc: The library version.

items.library: reads the library's version

items.name: result_name
items.doc: Returns the name of a result code, for diagnostics.

returns.doc: A static, NUL-terminated string such as "mrhi_errorCapacity".

args.name: result
args.doc: Any value; an unknown one is named as such.

items.library: names the library's result codes

items.name: diagnostic_code
items.doc: The check a diagnostic record reports (mrhi-0027): one check of the core that refused a call as invalid input, or, in a build with the validation layer, one rule of the driver SPI that the driver broke (the driver codes, recorded in the instance's queue). Codes are fixed from the first release that carries them, and only added after it; mrhiDiagnosticText gives each one's text.

values.name: diagnostic_null_argument
values.doc: A required pointer is NULL, or an array is NULL with a nonzero count.

values.name: diagnostic_def_header
values.doc: A def lacks its cookie (start from its default def), carries a malformed extension chain or one deeper than the chainDepth limit, or a label that is not UTF-8 of at most MRHI_LABEL_BYTES.

values.name: diagnostic_adapter_request_def
values.doc: An adapter request def is NULL, lacks its cookie or names an unknown power preference.

values.name: diagnostic_instance_has_devices
values.doc: An instance was destroyed while devices made on it live; nothing was destroyed.

values.name: diagnostic_surface_source
values.doc: A surface def names no surface source, or more than one.

values.name: diagnostic_surface_config
values.doc: A surface config names an unknown format, primaries, transfer or range, or a view format that is not its format's twin.

values.name: diagnostic_native_commands
values.doc: Native commands set without a command buffer, or on a pass not added as native.

values.name: diagnostic_recorded_in_native_pass
values.doc: A command recorded through the library in a native pass, whose commands are the program's own.

values.name: diagnostic_native_pass_def
values.doc: A native pass def with targets, query sets or a heap, or with an access that resolves queries or names a resource that is not imported.

values.name: diagnostic_pass_end_open
values.doc: A pass ended with a debug group or a query still open.

values.name: diagnostic_render_state_outside_render_pass
values.doc: A draw, a graphics pipeline or other draw state recorded in a pass without targets.

values.name: diagnostic_compute_outside_compute_pass
values.doc: A dispatch, a compute pipeline or a query resolve recorded in a pass that is not a compute pass.

values.name: diagnostic_transfer_in_render_pass
values.doc: A copy, clear, upload or readback recorded in a pass with targets.

values.name: diagnostic_graphics_pipeline_mismatch
values.doc: A graphics pipeline whose targets differ from the pass's, which writes depth or stencil the pass only reads, or which uses a heap the pass has none of.

values.name: diagnostic_compute_pipeline_heap
values.doc: A compute pipeline that uses a heap, set in a pass without one.

values.name: diagnostic_bindings_table
values.doc: Bindings set in a transfer pass, or for a table past the bindingTables limit.

values.name: diagnostic_bindings_count
values.doc: A binding count that is not the number of slots the pipeline's reflection gives the table.

values.name: diagnostic_bindings_slot
values.doc: A binding naming a slot the table lacks, or one already bound in the same call.

values.name: diagnostic_binding_resource
values.doc: A binding whose resource does not fit its slot: its kind, usage, range, format or the access the pass declares.

values.name: diagnostic_root_block
values.doc: A root block set in a transfer pass, empty, or at an offset or size not a multiple of 4.

values.name: diagnostic_vertex_buffer_slot
values.doc: A vertex buffer set at a slot past the vertexBuffers limit.

values.name: diagnostic_vertex_buffer_too_small
values.doc: A draw reading vertices or instances past the end of a vertex buffer it uses.

values.name: diagnostic_index_buffer_format
values.doc: An index buffer set with an unknown format.

values.name: diagnostic_dispatch_size
values.doc: A dispatch of more workgroups in a dimension than the workgroupsPerDimension limit.

values.name: diagnostic_indirect_count_limit
values.doc: A counted indirect draw whose maxCount is zero or past MRHI_INDIRECT_DRAWS.

values.name: diagnostic_viewport
values.doc: A viewport wider or taller than the textureDimension2d limit, outside twice that range, or with depths outside [0, 1] or in reverse order.

values.name: diagnostic_scissor
values.doc: A scissor rectangle reaching past the pass's targets.

values.name: diagnostic_blend_constant
values.doc: A blend constant that is not finite.

values.name: diagnostic_debug_label
values.doc: A debug label that is empty, not UTF-8, or longer than MRHI_LABEL_BYTES.

values.name: diagnostic_debug_group_underflow
values.doc: A debug group popped with none open.

values.name: diagnostic_resource_kind
values.doc: A texture given where a buffer is wanted, or a buffer where a texture is.

values.name: diagnostic_buffer_texture_copy
values.doc: A copy between a buffer and a texture whose layout the buffer cannot hold: an offset not a multiple of the texel block's bytes (4 for depth), bytes per row not a multiple of 256, rows or images shorter than the copy needs, or a region past the buffer.

values.name: diagnostic_texture_region
values.doc: A texture region off the format's blocks or past the mip, of a multisampled texture, or of an aspect that cannot be copied, or a buffer named as the texture.

values.name: diagnostic_copy_texture_mismatch
values.doc: A texture copy between formats that are neither equal nor sRGB twins, between sample counts that differ, or naming one aspect of a format that has two.

values.name: diagnostic_write_texture_layout
values.doc: A texture write whose layout the bytes cannot hold: rows or images shorter than the write needs, or a region past the bytes given.

values.name: diagnostic_frame_token
values.doc: A frame token this device never returned.

values.name: diagnostic_transient_usage
values.doc: A transient resource declared with a usage; the frame derives its usages from the passes' accesses.

values.name: diagnostic_seal_not_imported
values.doc: A resource sealed or unsealed that is not imported.

values.name: diagnostic_seal_texture
values.doc: A texture sealed without sampled usage, or an adopted image, which rests as a target.

values.name: diagnostic_heap_def
values.doc: A heap def with no entries.

values.name: diagnostic_heap_index
values.doc: A heap index past the heap's entries or samplers.

values.name: diagnostic_heap_entry
values.doc: A heap entry of an unknown kind.

values.name: diagnostic_heap_view
values.doc: A heap entry's view without the usage its kind needs, a storage view of more than one mip, or a sampled view marked writable.

values.name: diagnostic_heap_buffer
values.doc: A heap entry's buffer without storage usage, or a range misaligned, empty, not a multiple of 4 or past the buffer.

values.name: diagnostic_query_set_def
values.doc: A query set def of an unknown type, or of zero or too many queries.

values.name: diagnostic_occlusion_query
values.doc: An occlusion query begun in a pass without an occlusion set, while one is open, past the set or written twice in a frame; or ended with none open.

values.name: diagnostic_statistics_query
values.doc: A statistics query begun outside a graphics-class pass of one view, while one is open, on a set of another type, past the set or written twice in a frame; or ended with none open.

values.name: diagnostic_sampler_def
values.doc: A sampler def with an unknown filter, address mode or compare function, a negative or reversed level of detail range, or anisotropy outside 1 to 16 or above 1 without linear filtering.

values.name: diagnostic_buffer_size
values.doc: A buffer size of zero or not a multiple of 4.

values.name: diagnostic_buffer_usage
values.doc: A buffer def with no usage, or an unknown one.

values.name: diagnostic_shader_bytes
values.doc: Shader bytes that are NULL or not 8-byte aligned.

values.name: diagnostic_shader_container
values.doc: Shader bytes that are not a well-formed container: its bounds, version, digest or reflection.

values.name: diagnostic_texture_usage
values.doc: A texture def with a usage that is unknown or that its format, kind or sample count cannot take.

values.name: diagnostic_texture_adopt
values.doc: A texture adopting a Vulkan image without an image, or without render target usage.

values.name: diagnostic_view_def
values.doc: A view def with an unknown kind or aspect.

values.name: diagnostic_view_range
values.doc: A view whose mips, layers, format, aspect or kind its texture cannot give.

values.name: diagnostic_driver_request_tags
values.doc: A request reached the driver past the notifications limit, so its answer could not be matched.

values.name: diagnostic_driver_unasked_answer
values.doc: A driver answered a request it was never asked, or answered one twice.

values.name: diagnostic_driver_events_overrun
values.doc: A driver reported more events than the room it was given; the layer kept the room's worth.

values.name: diagnostic_driver_event_tag
values.doc: A device driver reported an event without a tag that is not a device loss.

values.name: diagnostic_driver_adapter
values.doc: A driver listed an adapter with a zero or repeated handle, a name longer than MRHI_ADAPTER_NAME_BYTES, or an unknown kind.

values.name: diagnostic_driver_sample_counts
values.doc: A driver reported format caps naming sample counts other than 1, 2 and 4.

values.name: diagnostic_driver_zero_handle
values.doc: A driver reported success for an object, surface or surface image with a zero handle.

values.name: diagnostic_driver_device_handshake
values.doc: A driver made a device whose vtable fails the SPI version and size handshake.

values.name: diagnostic_driver_timestamp_period
values.doc: A driver reported a negative timestamp period.

values.name: diagnostic_driver_memory_alignment
values.doc: A driver reported a memory alignment of zero or not a power of two.

values.name: diagnostic_driver_frame_walk
values.doc: A submitted frame failed the layer's walk: a handle, payload or range no driver could translate.

values.name: diagnostic_pipeline_entry
values.doc: A pipeline def names an entry point its shader lacks for the stage, gives a fragment entry length without a name, or names no vertex entry.

values.name: diagnostic_pipeline_constants
values.doc: A pipeline def's constant values name an id the shader lacks, give one twice, hold a value its type cannot, or leave out one without a default.

values.name: diagnostic_graphics_vertex
values.doc: A graphics pipeline's vertex state is malformed: its buffers or attributes, two attributes at one location, or a vertex input with no attribute of its scalar class.

values.name: diagnostic_graphics_primitive
values.doc: A graphics pipeline's primitive state has an unknown value, a strip index format for a list, or more than one view without multiview.

values.name: diagnostic_graphics_depth_stencil
values.doc: A graphics pipeline's depth and stencil state has an unknown value, an aspect's fields set without the aspect in the format, a bias that is not finite or set for points and lines, or no depth format while the fragment entry writes depth.

values.name: diagnostic_graphics_targets
values.doc: A graphics pipeline's color targets are more than MRHI_COLOR_TARGETS, present without a fragment entry, malformed (format, blend or writes), not written by the fragment entry's outputs as their types allow, or absent with no depth either.

values.name: diagnostic_graphics_multisample
values.doc: A graphics pipeline's sample count is not a power of two, or alpha to coverage is asked single-sampled, without a first target that has alpha, or while the fragment entry writes the sample mask.

values.name: diagnostic_graphics_interface
values.doc: A graphics pipeline's fragment input has no vertex output of the same location, type and interpolation, or a point list leaves no room for its point size.

values.name: diagnostic_chained_struct
values.doc: A chained struct the def carries is malformed: an adopted Vulkan object that is NULL, or an extension list that is not a list of names.

values.name: diagnostic_device_limits
values.doc: A device def's device limits include a zero, fewer than 2 notifications, a command arena under one chunk, or readback bytes not a multiple of 512.

values.name: diagnostic_limits_floor
values.doc: A device def asks for limits below the floor every adapter reaches.

values.name: diagnostic_allocator
values.doc: An allocator with one function set and the other not.

values.name: diagnostic_pipeline_cache_bytes
values.doc: A pipeline cache size given without its bytes.

values.name: diagnostic_texture_format
values.doc: A texture def names an unknown format.

values.name: diagnostic_texture_size
values.doc: A texture def's size or layers do not fit its kind and its format's block, or its mips are more than a full chain.

values.name: diagnostic_texture_samples
values.doc: A texture def's sample count is not 1, 2 or 4, or several samples are asked for a texture that is not 2D with one mip.

values.name: diagnostic_texture_view_formats
values.doc: A texture def's view format is neither unused nor its format's twin.

values.name: diagnostic_transfer_alignment
values.doc: An offset or size not a multiple of what the command needs: 4 for buffer copies, clears, uploads, readbacks, vertex buffers and indirect arguments, the index size for index buffers, 256 for query resolves.

values.name: diagnostic_transfer_range
values.doc: A range reaching past the end of its buffer, or past its query set.

values.name: diagnostic_undeclared_access
values.doc: A command reaching a resource the pass declares no covering access of the kind it needs.

values.name: diagnostic_pass_class
values.doc: A pass def with an unknown pass class.

values.name: diagnostic_pass_color_targets
values.doc: A pass def with more than MRHI_COLOR_TARGETS color targets.

values.name: diagnostic_pass_views
values.doc: A pass def with several views on a native pass or on one without targets.

values.name: diagnostic_pass_queries
values.doc: A pass def's query sets do not fit: an occlusion set that is not one or on a pass without targets, or timestamps that are not a graphics pass's two different queries, in range and not yet written this frame.

values.name: diagnostic_pass_uses
values.doc: A pass def's accesses or targets do not fit: a kind the resource's usage lacks, a range past it, a write to a sealed resource, targets whose sizes, samples, mips or layers disagree, uses that conflict within the pass, or a read of a declared resource no earlier pass wrote.

The instance starts it instead of the build's own driver. From a successful create the instance owns it and destroys it at its end; when the create fails, the program still owns it.

items.name: create_instance
items.doc: Makes an instance.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument, a def without its cookie, a zero limit, an allocator with one function, an external driver without a vtable or with one smaller than the library knows or lacking a function, or an external driver beside the test driver or Vulkan structs; `mrhi_errorVersion` when the def's contract version is not the library's, or an external driver's SPI version is not its; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` for a critical extension the library does not know, such as mrhiTestDriverDef in a build without the test driver; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the chain is deeper than the limit or the allocator fails.

args.name: instance_out
args.doc: Receives the instance; set to NULL on failure.

metal.note: nothing to make: the driver keeps its own state

items.name: destroy_instance
items.doc: Destroys an instance. While any of its devices exists it refuses, counting the call as misuse and destroying nothing.

args.name: instance
args.doc: The instance, or NULL for nothing.

items.name: get_instance_misuse
items.doc: Returns how many calls the instance has refused as invalid input (mrhi_errorInvalid): a count release builds can watch to catch a caller's bugs. Stale ids are not misuse.

returns.doc: The count; 0 for a NULL instance.

items.library: reads the library's misuse count

items.name: next_instance_diagnostic
items.doc: Takes the oldest record from the instance's diagnostic queue (mrhi-0027), which holds a record for each call the instance refused as invalid input and, in a build with the validation layer, for each rule of the driver SPI its driver or its devices' drivers broke, up to the diagnostics limit; those past it are counted but not recorded.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success` with a record; `mrhi_empty` when the queue is drained or keeps none; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument.

args.name: diagnostic_out
args.doc: Receives the record; untouched unless one is taken.

items.library: reads the library's own diagnostic queue

items.name: get_driver_faults
items.doc: Returns how many breaches of the driver SPI the validation layer has found on the instance and its devices (mrhi-0025): frames no driver could translate, and driver answers no core could trust. Builds without the layer (MAUL_RHI_VALIDATION) find none.

returns.doc: The count; 0 for a NULL instance or a build without the layer.

items.library: reads the library's validation layer count

items.name: default_adapter_request_def
items.doc: Returns the default adapter request def: the driver's own order, software rasterizers allowed.

returns.doc: The def, with a valid cookie.

items.library: fills a def with the library's defaults

items.name: seal_resource
items.doc: Ends an imported texture or buffer of the open frame sealed (mrhi-0015): after the frame's passes it moves to the sealed state, the frame that uploads it sealing it without a frame of its own. From the next frame on any pass may read it through a heap without declaring it, and a frame that imports it may declare only the reads the sealed state allows (a texture sampled; a buffer as uniforms, vertices, indices, indirect arguments or storage read) until it is unsealed. Writing it through a heap while it is sealed is invalid, with undefined results. Sealing it again does nothing. Needs the bindless_sampling feature.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a resource the frame declared, a surface image, or a texture without sampled usage; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` without the bindless_sampling feature; `mrhi_errorState` for a device without an open frame or with a compiled one; `mrhi_errorStale` for a resource not of the open frame, or whose object the device no longer has.

items.library: marks the resource; the compile ends it in the sealed state

items.name: unseal_resource
items.doc: Returns an imported texture or buffer of the open frame to the graph's tracking (mrhi-0015): passes added after it may declare any use of it, and it leaves the frame in its last use's state. Undoes a seal made earlier in the frame; sealing it after unsealing ends it sealed again. Unsealing a resource that is not sealed does nothing. Needs the bindless_sampling feature.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a resource the frame declared, or a surface image; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` without the bindless_sampling feature; `mrhi_errorState` for a device without an open frame or with a compiled one; `mrhi_errorStale` for a resource not of the open frame, or whose object the device no longer has.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass without targets, a format that is not an index width, a resource that is not a buffer the pass declares with the index access, or an offset or size out of range or not a multiple of the index width; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame, a destroyed pipeline, or a resource that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: size

metal.note: kept for the indexed draws, which take it as arguments

items.name: draw
items.doc: Draws vertices with the pass's pipeline, tables and vertex buffers.

args.name: pass
args.doc: The pass, recording, with a graphics pipeline set.

items.name: dispatch

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass that renders or copies, or a count past the device's workgroupsPerDimension; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or a destroyed pipeline; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording, has no pipeline set, or lacks a table the pipeline reads; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: pass

metal.note: dispatchThreadgroups with the pipeline's group size

items.name: draw_indirect
items.doc: Draws with the pass's pipeline, tables and vertex buffers, the arguments read on the GPU: the vertices, the instances, the first vertex and the first instance, 32-bit each. A first instance other than zero without the indirect_first_instance feature makes the draw do nothing.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass without targets, or a resource that is not a buffer the pass declares with the indirect access, or an offset not a multiple of 4 or without the arguments' bytes after it; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame, a destroyed pipeline, or a resource that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording, has no pipeline set, or lacks a table or vertex buffer the pipeline reads; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: pass
args.doc: The pass, recording, with a graphics pipeline set.

args.name: resource
args.doc: A buffer of the open frame the pass declares with the indirect access, holding the arguments.

args.name: offset
args.doc: The arguments' first byte, a multiple of 4, with 16 bytes after it in the buffer.

items.name: draw_indexed_indirect
items.doc: Draws indexed vertices with the pass's pipeline, tables, vertex and index buffers, the arguments read on the GPU: the indices, the instances, the first index, the base vertex (signed) and the first instance, 32-bit each. A first instance other than zero without the indirect_first_instance feature makes the draw do nothing.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass without targets, or a resource that is not a buffer the pass declares with the indirect access, or an offset not a multiple of 4 or without the arguments' bytes after it; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame, a destroyed pipeline, or a resource that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording, has no pipeline set, lacks a table or vertex buffer the pipeline reads, or has no index buffer of the pipeline's strip index format; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: resource
args.doc: A buffer of the open frame the pass declares with the indirect access, holding the arguments.

args.name: offset

d3d12.cost: for such a pipeline, two buffer copies and two barriers per draw

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` for a device without the multi_draw_indirect_count feature; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a maxCount of 0 or past MRHI_INDIRECT_DRAWS, a pass without targets, or an arguments or count resource that is not a buffer the pass declares with the indirect access, or an offset not a multiple of 4 or without maxCount records, or the count's 4 bytes, after it; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame, a destroyed pipeline, or a resource that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording, has no pipeline set, or lacks a table or vertex buffer the pipeline reads; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full, or its counted draws would pass the device's frameIndirectDraws.

args.name: resource

items.name: dispatch_indirect
items.doc: Dispatches workgroups with the pass's compute pipeline and tables, the counts in x, y and z read on the GPU, 32-bit each. A count past the device's workgroupsPerDimension makes the dispatch do nothing.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass that renders or copies, or a resource that is not a buffer the pass declares with the indirect access, or an offset not a multiple of 4 or without the arguments' bytes after it; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame, a destroyed pipeline, or a resource that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording, has no pipeline set, or lacks a table the pipeline reads; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: pass
args.doc: The pass, recording, with a compute pipeline set.

args.name: resource
args.doc: A buffer of the open frame the pass declares with the indirect access, holding the counts.

args.name: offset
args.doc: The arguments' first byte, a multiple of 4, with 12 bytes after it in the buffer.

items.name: begin_occlusion_query
items.doc: Begins an occlusion query of the pass's occlusion query set: the draws until its end write whether any sample passed. A query is written at most once in a frame.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass without an occlusion query set, a query past the set's count or already written in this frame, or a query already open in the pass; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or a destroyed query set; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: pass
args.doc: The pass, recording, with an occlusion query set.

args.name: query
args.doc: The query, below the set's count.

items.name: end_occlusion_query
items.doc: Ends the pass's open occlusion query. One refused for capacity still ends it, so the pass can end.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device or a pass without an open occlusion query; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: pass
args.doc: The pass, recording, with an occlusion query open.

items.name: begin_statistics_query
items.doc: Begins a pipeline statistics query: the pass's work until its end is counted. A query is written at most once in a frame.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass not of the graphics class or rendering several views, a set that is not of statistics queries, a query past the set's count or already written in this frame, or a statistics query already open in the pass; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or a destroyed query set; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: pass
args.doc: The pass, recording, of the graphics class, rendering one view.

args.name: set
args.doc: A query set of pipeline statistics queries.

args.name: query
args.doc: The query, below the set's count.

items.name: end_statistics_query
items.doc: Ends the pass's open statistics query. One refused for capacity still ends it, so the pass can end.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device or a pass without an open statistics query; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: pass
args.doc: The pass, recording, with a statistics query open.

items.name: resolve_queries
items.doc: Writes queries of a set into a buffer as 64-bit values: an occlusion query's result, a timestamp in ticks, or a statistics query's eleven counters. A query not written earlier in the frame reads zeros.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass with targets or not of the graphics class, queries past the set's count or a first query at or past it, a resource that is not a buffer the pass declares with the query resolve access, or an offset not a multiple of 256 or without the queries' bytes after it (88 per statistics query, 8 per other); `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame, a destroyed query set, or a resource that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.doc: The pass, recording, of the graphics class without targets.

args.name: first
args.doc: The first query, below the set's count.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument, a pass with targets, offsets or a size not a multiple of 4, a range past either buffer, or one buffer as both, or a resource the pass declares no covering copy source or destination access of; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or a resource that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: destination

args.name: destination_offset
args.doc: Its first byte, a multiple of 4.

items.doc: Writes zeros into a range of a buffer of the frame (mrhi-0022).

headers.doc: Vulkan objects made outside the library, for OpenXR (XR_KHR_vulkan_enable2): instances and devices adopted with what they were made with, a device described for the runtime to make, its swapchain images adopted as textures, the queries a session binds with, and the native objects and passes an upscaler records with. Every other driver refuses the structs and answers the functions unsupported.

items.name: instance_vulkan_adopt
items.doc: A VkInstance made elsewhere (by an OpenXR runtime through XR_KHR_vulkan_enable2), which the instance adopts and never destroys, chained on an instance def with the type mrhi_structInstanceVulkanAdopt. Vulkan only. An instance older than 1.3, or one whose functions cannot be read, is refused with mrhi_errorUnsupported; so is the struct alongside the test driver's.

members.name: instance
members.doc: The VkInstance, made with Vulkan 1.3 or later.

members.name: extensions
members.doc: The names of the extensions it was made with, each ended by a NUL, in extensionsLength bytes. Only read during the call: surfaces and labels are used only where their extensions are named.

members.name: extensions_length

items.name: instance_vulkan_extensions
items.doc: Extensions the Vulkan instance enables beyond the library's own (an OpenXR runtime's, through XR_KHR_vulkan_enable), chained on an instance def with the type mrhi_structInstanceVulkanExtensions. Vulkan only. An instance the loader cannot make with them is refused with mrhi_errorUnsupported, as is the struct alongside the test driver's or an adopted instance's (mrhi_errorInvalid).

members.name: extensions

items.name: device_vulkan_adopt
items.doc: A VkDevice made from the instance's last description (mrhiDescribeVulkanDevice) of an equal device def, which the device adopts and never destroys, chained on a device def with the type mrhi_structDeviceVulkanAdopt. Vulkan only. Without such a description the def is refused with mrhi_errorInvalid; on another driver's adapter with mrhi_errorUnsupported.

members.name: device
members.doc: The VkDevice.

items.name: device_vulkan_extensions
items.doc: Extensions and features the Vulkan device enables beyond the library's own (an upscaler's, such as XeSS's or Streamline's), chained on a device def with the type mrhi_structDeviceVulkanExtensions; a description includes them. Vulkan only. The names are copied at the call, and those the library enables itself are named once; on another driver's adapter the def is refused with mrhi_errorUnsupported.

members.name: extensions
members.doc: The extensions' names, each ended by a NUL, in extensionsLength bytes. Only read during the call.

members.name: extensions_length
members.doc: The bytes of extensions.

members.name: features
members.doc: A chain of Vulkan feature structs (VkBaseInStructure) to enable as well, or NULL: VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 and the 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3 feature structs, whose true members are merged into the library's; a def with any other struct is refused with mrhi_errorUnsupported, since the library cannot place a struct it does not know the size of. Only read during the call.

items.name: texture_vulkan_adopt
items.doc: A VkImage made elsewhere (an OpenXR runtime's swapchain image), which the device adopts as a texture and never destroys, nor its memory, chained on a texture def given to mrhiCreateTexture with the type mrhi_structTextureVulkanAdopt. The def states the image's format, kind, size, layers, mips, samples, usage and view formats, which Vulkan cannot report; its usage includes mrhi_textureRenderTarget. Between frames the image rests as a render target, in VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL for a color format or VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL for a depth one, owned by the device's queue: it must be so when adopted, and every frame that uses it leaves it so, as OpenXR hands images over and takes them back. It cannot be sealed. On another driver's device the def is refused with mrhi_errorUnsupported.

members.name: image
members.doc: The VkImage.

items.name: describe_vulkan_device
items.doc: Describes the Vulkan device a device def would make: the VkDeviceCreateInfo and the VkPhysicalDevice the driver would pass to vkCreateDevice, for a program whose OpenXR runtime makes the device (xrCreateVulkanDeviceKHR). The description stays valid until the instance's next description, refused or not, or its end; a device made from it is adopted with mrhiDeviceVulkanAdopt.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` where the instance's driver is not Vulkan, or for a def the adapter cannot take; `mrhi_errorStale` for an adapter the instance no longer has; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument or a malformed def.

args.name: def

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` where the instance's driver is not Vulkan; `mrhi_errorStale` for an adapter the instance no longer has; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument.

items.name: get_vulkan_texture
items.doc: Reads a device texture's Vulkan image. In a native pass the texture is in the layout its access puts it in: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL for mrhi_accessSampled, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL for the storage accesses, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL and VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL for the copies.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` where the device's driver is not Vulkan; `mrhi_errorStale` for a texture the device no longer has; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument.

items.name: set_vulkan_pass_commands
items.doc: Hands a native pass the command buffer the program recorded for it: a primary VkCommandBuffer from the program's own pool on the device's queue family, ended and not submitted. The library submits it at the pass's place in the frame, after the library's commands before it and before those after it; it must leave every declared resource in its access's layout (mrhiGetVulkanTexture), and may change any other state. The program keeps it alive until the frame is done.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` where the device's driver is not Vulkan; `mrhi_errorState` outside the pass's recording, or for a pass that already has one; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL command buffer or a pass that is not native.

headers.name: d3d12
headers.doc: D3D12 objects for vendor upscalers (mrhi-0019): the device's native objects, a texture's resource, and the command list a native pass runs. Every other driver answers the functions unsupported.

items.name: get_d3d12_device
items.doc: Reads a D3D12 device's native objects, borrowed for the device's life with no reference added: what an upscaler's context is made from (the FidelityFX SDK's backend, XeSS's xessD3D12CreateContext).

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` where the device's driver is not D3D12; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument.

args.name: queue_out
args.doc: Receives the ID3D12CommandQueue* the device submits on.

d3d12.note: the device and its direct queue

items.name: get_d3d12_texture
items.doc: Reads a device texture's ID3D12Resource, borrowed with no reference added. In a native pass the texture is in the state its access puts it in: D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE | D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE for mrhi_accessSampled, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS for the storage accesses, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE and D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST for the copies; a buffer is in D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON, promoted on its first use, as buffers decay between command lists.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` where the device's driver is not D3D12; `mrhi_errorStale` for a texture the device no longer has; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument.

items.name: set_d3d12_pass_commands
items.doc: Hands a native pass the command list the program recorded for it: an ID3D12GraphicsCommandList of the direct type, closed and not executed. The library executes it at the pass's place in the frame, after the library's lists before it and before those after it, each in its own ExecuteCommandLists; it must leave every declared texture in its access's state (mrhiGetD3d12Texture), and may change any other state, its descriptor heaps and root signatures included. The program keeps it alive until the frame is done.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` where the device's driver is not D3D12; `mrhi_errorState` outside the pass's recording, or for a pass that already has one; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL list or a pass that is not native.

headers.name: metal
headers.doc: Metal objects for vendor upscalers and MetalFX (mrhi-0019): the device's native objects, a texture, and the command buffer a native pass runs. Every other driver answers the functions unsupported.

items.name: get_metal_device
items.doc: Reads a Metal device's native objects, borrowed for the device's life with no reference added: what an upscaler is made from (MetalFX's MTLFXTemporalScalerDescriptor makes its scaler from the MTLDevice).

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` where the device's driver is not Metal; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument.

args.name: queue_out
args.doc: Receives the id<MTLCommandQueue> the device commits to.

items.name: get_metal_texture
items.doc: Reads a device texture's id<MTLTexture>, borrowed with no reference added. Metal tracks its hazards, so a native pass needs no state.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` where the device's driver is not Metal; `mrhi_errorStale` for a texture the device no longer has; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument.

items.name: set_metal_pass_commands
items.doc: Hands a native pass the command buffer the program encoded for it: an id<MTLCommandBuffer> from the device's queue (mrhiGetMetalDevice), with no encoder open, neither enqueued nor committed. The library commits it at the pass's place in the frame, after the library's command buffer before it and before the one after it, and the frame is done only once it has completed too. The program keeps it alive until then.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` where the device's driver is not Metal; `mrhi_errorState` outside the pass's recording, or for a pass that already has one; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL command buffer or a pass that is not native.
